svg.title: Where the pool has room, and as calls overlap
svg.desc: In panel a, with 16 agent sessions of the whole corpus, where the pool has room, tuned vLLM's V2V p95 and the configuration to deploy's in each of five rounds against the SLO of 2.03 s (2.15 and 2.04 s, 3.83 and 2.42 s, 3.07 and 2.12 s, 2.30 and 2.05 s, 2.52 and 2.02 s); in panels b to d, the configuration to deploy with two, four and six callers beside 24 agent sessions, on the same three samples of the agents, each run's p95 over that many callers' SLO, the share of the engine's steps in which the budget cap held agent prefill, and the agents' tokens a second over the calls' first 240 s (2 callers, +202 ms over their SLO of 2.03 s at the median of 9 runs (+98 to +267), agent prefill held in 33% of the steps, the agents at 3,156 tokens/s; 4 callers, +269 ms over their SLO of 2.04 s at the median of 3 runs (+206 to +370), agent prefill held in 53% of the steps, the agents at 3,055 tokens/s; 6 callers, +257 ms over their SLO of 2.13 s at the median of 3 runs (+226 to +333), agent prefill held in 64% of the steps, the agents at 2,716 tokens/s).
